title: serve
description: `serve` throws when the built app is missing, listens on 127.0.0.1, or on every interface (`NETWORK_HOST`) for `lathe serve --network`, which prints `networkUrls` beside the loopback address; it watches the data folders (`watchTargets`) and, 50 ms after a burst of file events, has the API read the changed tables again (`dataFilesChanged`); it writes each change the API announces to the open event streams as a named `spec:changed` event, answers `/api/` paths through `handleApi` (which refuses writes from any address but loopback and marks its answers to other devices `x-lathe-access: read-only`) and serves the app's files, falling back to index.html. Its stop closes the watchers and connections, waits for the reload and the requests in progress, then closes the stores and the engine.

title: upgradeProduct
description: `upgradeProduct` refuses a git working tree with changes, or no git, and a missing converter (`readConverters`), runs every converter on the raw rows, then opens the store, which runs every aggregate's rules, and rewrites the touched tables in its order; only then does it write the new schema version to the config. When the data does not load, it stops with the reasons as to-dos.
